evidence.title: Welcome to Factory
evidence.finding: Factory offers Mac and Windows desktop installers, CLI installation on three OS families and browser access through session sync and remote computers.

evidence.title: Droid Computers
evidence.finding: Factory-managed persistent computers retain packages, files, services and configuration. User-managed hosts use a separate Remote Control route.

evidence.title: Factory Missions
evidence.locator: What Missions do; How it works
evidence.finding: Missions plan features and milestones before orchestrated execution, with validation that depends on a scriptable repository environment.

evidence.title: Workstreams
evidence.finding: Workstreams beta coordinates a persistent orchestrator, agents, shared files and PRs; available plans explicitly exclude Business and Enterprise at this check.

evidence.title: Automations
evidence.finding: The legacy Software Factory overview now presents Automations, with scheduled, Slack, GitHub Actions and webhook triggers.

evidence.title: Factory pricing
evidence.finding: Pro is $20/month, Plus $100 and Max $200; Teams adds a team fee and seats, while managed computers start in Plus.

evidence.title: Factory App Worktrees
evidence.finding: Factory creates separate Git checkouts and branches, with ephemeral or persistent lifecycles and setup profiles. Non-Git folders can start without worktrees; isolation is file separation, not a security sandbox.

evidence.title: Steer a Workstream
evidence.finding: The orchestrator delegates to agents, briefs them, sends follow-up work, interrupts turns and collects results. Agents show waiting/working/idle states. /migrate requires an approved plan and displays progress.

evidence.title: Workstream Shared Folder
evidence.finding: Orchestrator and workers share synchronized plans, findings and deliverables across machines. Humans upload files/folders and download outputs. Organization controls can disable shared folders separately from message sync.

evidence.title: Workstream Pull Requests
evidence.finding: Workstreams list open, draft, closed and merged PRs with checks and review counts. PR tabs show diffs, walkthrough, validation, review and merge actions; GitHub supports draft/close/reopen actions.

evidence.title: Missions Planning and Validation
evidence.finding: Milestones trigger validation workers; QA validation can be disabled in mission settings. Planning estimates count feature and validation workers but are not measured cost guarantees.

evidence.title: Workstream Settings and Usage
evidence.finding: Usage shows total credits, agent counts and per-session model/cost shares. A 90% banner warns before agents stop at plan/org limits. Default routing can use additional machines or fresh environment computers.

evidence.title: Identity and Access
evidence.finding: Owner controls the organization and billing. Manager administers members, settings and service accounts. User cannot override locked organization settings. SAML/OIDC and directory synchronization map groups to roles.

evidence.title: Airgapped Deployment
evidence.locator: How Airgap Mode behaves; Network contract; Availability
evidence.finding: Enterprise custom airgap deployments run all Factory inside the customer network. The full local harness skips sign-in, sync, Factory telemetry and crash reporting. It uses configured model endpoints and an optional customer collector, with cloud features unavailable.

evidence.title: Data Flows and Privacy
evidence.finding: Managed and default Private control planes are Factory-hosted. Private sandboxes stay in the customer VPC. Operational logs, session storage and provider traffic have separate retention and routing controls.

evidence.title: Factory Audit Log
evidence.finding: Enterprise owners see organization audit events with actor, source, target, payload and timestamp. Events include role/settings/key/integration changes, not an assertion of complete agent-decision history.

evidence.title: Compliance and Audit
evidence.finding: Factory lists SOC 2 Type II, ISO 27001 and ISO 42001 and links its Trust Center for reports, architecture and subprocessors. Underlying assurance documents were not inspected.

evidence.title: Factory Individual Terms
evidence.finding: Factory grants a limited internal-use service/software license, reserves service IP and restricts modification and source discovery. Main application licensing is custom rather than the license of any separate SDK.

evidence.title: Workstream Machines
evidence.finding: Environment and managed Droid Computer agents continue when the laptop closes. Local agents stop when the desktop app quits; user remote computers must remain online.
